name: shiksha-image-generation-tutorial
title: Generate and explore a learning image

chapters.caption: 01  Open a course and explore its four conversation starters.
02  Describe the image you want, including its subject and useful labels.
03  Follow the native image-generation loading state.
04  Review the illustration and its explanation inside the conversation.
05  Open the native image preview to inspect the complete illustration.
06  Return to chat and ask your TA to explain the image's energy flow.

description: Request an illustration, follow its native loading state, open the image preview and discuss the energy flow with your course TA.

image.source: Original local SVG rasterized for an isolated synthetic tool-response fixture; not live model output.

capture: Actual unchanged React frontend; scripted interactions, synthetic course data and in-memory API responses.
timing: Captured frames are paced for readability, not a performance benchmark.
isolation: Fresh browser context. External services blocked; all API calls simulated. No remote course creation.
